item.title: Gravegonzo - "Whatever, Forever" | Obscure Sound
item.description: Conjuring a sound that melds an intriguing dream-pop lushness alongside an artful production with shades of Burial in its vocal samples, “Whatever, Forever” is a memorable track from Peckham, UK-based act Gravegonzo. Soulful glimpses of various vocals are infused within a gliding synth line, while backing pads add a ghostly glow. item.title: Persona Barter - "| Detached |" | Obscure Sound
item.description: A wintry, dreamy pop glow emanates throughout “| Detached |,” a newly released track from New Haven, CT-based artist Persona Barter. Glistening, bouncy synths and subdued percussion complement a consuming vocal layering, tonally reminiscent of Wild Beasts in its theatrical croon. item.title: GiGi Girls - "Il Futuro" | Obscure Sound
item.description: A stylishly infectious electro-pop charmer, “Il Futuro” is a replay-inducer of a track from Cologne, Germany-based act GiGi Girls, who embrace Italo disco nostalgia infused with modern dream-pop and electro-pop savvy. Driving synth-bass and flourishes of glistening electronics bolster dynamic vocal work, spanning from ethereal wordless harmonizing to debonair lyrical drives. item.title: Sockeye - "Big Cash Prize" | Obscure Sound
item.description: An emotively gripping track from New York-based Sockeye, “Big Cash Prize” infuses a steady piano arpeggio, haunting strings, and dynamic vocals for a wholly captivating sound. Pitter-pattering percussion pairs with these dreamy, intriguing aspects of instrumentation that compliment an initially subdued vocal presence, immersing in its overall build-up to the ghostly expanse thereafter. item.title: Nansy - "Running Into You" | Obscure Sound
item.description: New single "Running Into You" achieves a serenely engaging indie pop appeal, marking a fantastic return for Norwegian group Nansy.

item.description: A hazy, contemplative success from Swedish artist Deymond Nat, “Mirror Lake” shows well across both murky introspections and vibrant harmoniousness. item.description: Featuring the excellent tracks “Lost In Time” and “Everything Is Right,” Burning Scar is a stellar new album from Lotus Seeds, excelling across both moody dream-pop and fervent rock expanses.
